trial_court: Family Court, D.K. Mangaluru, I.A.No.VI in G & WC No.4 of 2019
case_name: Krishnan Ratnakaran Nambiar vs Satya Krishnan Nee Reddy
facts_of_case: Marriage between the two takes place on 24-11-2003 at Kollur. From and out of the wedlock the couple have two children - a son born on 11-06-2008 and a daughter born on 03-06-2009. The marriage began to flounder which led to execution of a settlement agreement styled as a separation agreement between the two and their respective fathers laying certain conditions with regard to separation, custody, visitation and maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to deny maintenance to show that the other party has breached the separation agreement.
legal_principles.held: Fault lies on both sides. He would submit that the petitioner is ready and willing to pay maintenance, as also education expenses of the children.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the atmosphere created by a party when seeking custody or visitation rights.
legal_principles.held: he has not provided conducive atmosphere for the children to be with him

outcome.final_order: The petitioner's writ petition is allowed.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet
